tickerText: [TENNIS] Post-Wimbledon clay swing rolls on Friday at Gstaad, Bastad and Umag — Stefanos Tsitsipas faces Arthur Rinderknech in Gstaad quarters after surviving Jerome Kym in a third-set tiebreak, while WTA 250 action continues in Iasi and Athens • [SQUASH] Mostafa Asal rallies from two sets down to beat Ali Farag 6-11, 7-11, 11-9, 11-9, 11-5 in the El Gouna International final, claiming his second title in Egypt and a fifth trophy of the season • [BADMINTON] PV Sindhu advances to the Japan Open Super 750 semifinals after Nozomi Okuhara withdraws — the Indian will face Olympic champion Chen Yufei after stunning world No. 5 Han Yue in the previous round • [PICKLEBALL] The Macon PPA Challenger opens Friday at Rhythm & Rally with 500-plus pros from 37 states and 15 countries — singles day kicks off the first pro event at the world's largest indoor pickleball facility • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar wraps its final day of U11, U15 and U19 singles at the Buyant-Ukhaa Sports Complex, while U Mumba TT tops Ultimate Table Tennis Season 7 after a 9-6 win over Pune

newsItems.title: Tsitsipas Survives Kym Scare to Reach Gstaad Quarters
newsItems.excerpt: Stefanos Tsitsipas edged Swiss wild card Jerome Kym 6-4, 6-7(2), 7-6(5) in a rain-interrupted thriller to reach the Swiss Open quarter-finals. The Greek faces Arthur Rinderknech on Friday as the post-Wimbledon European clay swing continues at Gstaad, Bastad and Umag.

newsItems.title: Asal Stages Epic Comeback to Beat Farag at El Gouna
newsItems.excerpt: Mostafa Asal rallied from two sets down to defeat world No. 1 Ali Farag 6-11, 7-11, 11-9, 11-9, 11-5 in the El Gouna International final, winning his second title in Egypt and a fifth trophy of the 2025/26 season.

newsItems.title: Sindhu Into Japan Open Semis After Okuhara Walkover
newsItems.excerpt: PV Sindhu reached the Japan Open Super 750 semifinals after Nozomi Okuhara withdrew from their quarterfinal. The Indian will face Olympic champion Chen Yufei, having stunned world No. 5 Han Yue 21-16, 21-14 in the previous round.

newsItems.title: U Mumba TT Tops UTT Season 7 Standings
newsItems.excerpt: Reigning champions U Mumba TT beat PBG Pune Jaguars 9-6 in Goa to claim a second straight Ultimate Table Tennis Season 7 win and move to the top of the standings. The WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar also concludes Friday in Mongolia.
